header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR
(Bilawal Khan v. P.O Sindh and others)
For Petitioner : Mr. Badaruddin Memon, Advocate
For Respondents : M/s Ali Raza Balouch & Israr Ahmed
body: Andan Iqbal Chaudhry J.- In the recruitment process held in the year 2024, the petitioner was selected for the post of Driver Police Constable in the Sindh Police, District Sukkur. However, upon the requisite medical screening test, he was found to be infected with Hepatitis “C” virus and, therefore, his selection was withdrawn. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the screening process was defective and prays that the petitioner may be rescreened by the department from another lab.

The comments filed by the SSP Sukkur reflect that the petitioner‟s case, along with 22 other candidates, was taken up by the Recruitment Board on 15.08.2024, which reaffirmed the decision to withdraw his selection after verifying the medical report. The recruitment process, during which the petitioner was found infected with Hepatitis “C”, has since concluded. We are not inclined to re-open the same by way of a re-screening exercise for that would be discrimination against other candidates who were declined for the same reason. However, if the petitioner is now cured from Hepatitis “C”, the previous process does not disqualify him from applying afresh as and when fresh vacancies are advertised. With that observation, the petition is dismissed. J U D G E J U D G E M.Ali*
